Name: Skip Dialogue
Author: Kevorama0205
Description:
[b]Skip Dialogue[/b] allows you to skip repetitive texts at your own pace. Whenever a character is talking to you, or you are reading mail, press the key ("k" by default) and skip it! No questions or rewards/quests will be skipped, only walls of text you don't care about.

There are 3 speed settings:
[b]Speed 0:[/b] you won't miss a word, as all it does is put the text on the screen immediately, or turn the mail pages forward.
[b]Speed 1 (default):[/b] it will skip one box of dialogue or two pages of mail, possibly ending the conversation or discarding the mail (but not questions, quests, or rewards)
[b]Speed 2+:[/b] It will skip that many boxes or pages each time. Since there are usually only a few in a row, this number needn't be too high.

[b]Installation:[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.﻿
[/list][list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer (even if other players don't have it).
[*]should be compatible with all other SMAPI mods if [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Key_bindings]key bindings don't conflict[/url]﻿
[/list]
[/list]
